module.name: holoscan-clustering
module.description: Euclidean clustering of point clouds into objects on the GPU, for organized or unorganized XYZ clouds in holoscan-point-cloud's layout: connected components of points within a tolerance, found with a uniform grid and union-find on the GPU (or the faster image neighborhood of an organized cloud), filtered by size and sorted by it, deterministic. Emits a cluster label per point and a summary per cluster with its point count, centroid, axis-aligned box and optional PCA oriented box, and optionally the clustered points and colors, organized or packed by cluster.

hardware.name: NVIDIA GPU
hardware.description: A CUDA-capable GPU supported by the Holoscan SDK.
